scripts.cf:deploy:staging: sh ./cloudflare/staging/build.sh && node ./cloudflare/shared/check-target.mjs staging && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.jsonc --tag "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" --message "git-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.cf:check:production: node ./cloudflare/shared/check-target.mjs production production-incomplete && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-production
scripts.cf:deploy:production: sh ./cloudflare/production/build.sh && node ./cloudflare/shared/check-target.mjs production --clean && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.production.jsonc --tag "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" --message "git-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
